description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenSSL error handling functions, specifically testing error queue behavior, error string formatting, error state saving/restoring, and macro/error handling. It is a test source file for the error module in BoringSSL/OpenSSL.

methods.name: ERR_put_error
methods.description: Adds an error code to the thread's error queue.

methods.name: ERR_add_error_data
methods.description: Adds additional data to the current error.

methods.name: ERR_get_error
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the earliest error from the queue.

methods.name: ERR_get_error_line_data
methods.description: Retrieves error info including file, line, data, and flags.

methods.name: ERR_peek_error_line_data
methods.description: Peeks at the error info without removing it.

methods.name: ERR_set_error_data
methods.description: Sets the error data for the current error.

methods.name: ERR_save_state
methods.description: Saves the current error queue state.

methods.name: ERR_restore_state
methods.description: Restores a saved error queue state.

methods.name: ERR_error_string_n
methods.description: Converts an error code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: ERR_lib_error_string
methods.description: Returns string description of error library code.

methods.name: ERR_reason_error_string
methods.description: Returns string description of error reason code.

methods.name: ERR_PACK
methods.description: Creates a packed error code from library and reason.
